_doc: Hand hints for make_skyridge_maps.py (same keys as ../wotc-aquapolis/aquapolis_hints.json, plus opaque_color / opaque_close: a colour rule over H (deg), S, V (0-1) that forces the Pokemon's own inks matte). Card coordinates of the 600 x 838 scan.

H27.note: Rhydon: the dark rocks scan with scattered patches; drop the small foil islands

H29.note: Steelix: the black body and silver spikes read as foil; forced matte by ink
